Senator&mdash;''"<br />"''My wife's cousin is a tac officer on the ''Dancer''.''"<br />"''Then, Senator, I am sorry for your loss.|Obi-Wan Kenobi reports the loss of Breha Organa's cousin to Senator Bail Organa|<ref name="WS" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''cousin''' of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they served as a [[Tactical officer/Legends|tactical officer]] aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Bespin Dancer]]''. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Human was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the ''Dancer'' was destroyed while [[Fall of Falleen|combating]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Before we jump to hyperspace I'd like to tell Breha&mdash;my wife&mdash;about the ''Bespin Dancer''. Do you have a problem with that?''"<br />"''It might be better if you didn't, Senator. It's sensitive information, and there is the question of security.|Bail Organa and Obi-Wan Kenobi discuss telling Breha the fate of her cousin|<ref name="WS" />}}
[[File:BrehaOrgana-SithSnapshot.png|thumb|200px|right|The individual was the cousin of Breha Organa (pictured).]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the cousin of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha Organa]], the incumbent monarch of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Although only cousins, the two had a very good relationship, more like that of brother and sister. The Queen's cousin served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the Clone Wars and was a [[Tactical officer/Legends|tactical officer]] aboard the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Bespin Dancer]]''.<ref name="WS" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the ''Bespin Dancer'' [[Fall of Falleen|engaged]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces over the planet [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. During the battle, all Republic ships in the engagement were destroyed, including the ''Bespin Dancer''. The destruction of the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Organa's cousin, who was aboard the ship at the [[Time/Legends|time]]. On the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] affirmed the destruction of the ''Bespin Dancer'' and the death of Organa's cousin when he spoke to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], the Queen's [[Marriage/Legends|husband]]. Bail Organa went on to tell his wife about the demise of her cousin, although Kenobi advised him against it, as it was in violation of protocol.<ref name="WS" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But I still don't advise that you discuss the ''Bespin Dancer''{{'s}} fate with your wife. I don't know what Palpatine has authorized, in terms of information being made available to the public.''"<br />"''Breha is not ''the public''. She's the head of the Alderaan government. And it's her cousin who's died. They grew up together. They're more like brother and sister. I don't want her finding out from a HoloNet news bulletin or in some impersonal Senate communiqué. I want her to hear it from me.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Bail Organa|<ref name="WS" />}}
The Human and Breha Organa had a special relationship between them like brother and sister, despite only being cousins. Bail Organa thought that his wife should know about the death of her cousin from him and not from a simple [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] message, even going so far as arguing with Obi-Wan Kenobi about sending a transmission. During the Clone Wars, the individual served in the Republic Navy.<ref name="WS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The individual was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="WS" />
